comment: Census of Godot virtual methods from godot_headers/extension_api.json. Regenerate with the snippet in this change's tasks.md history; criterion documented below. Category C (creation-info routed) never appears in extension_api.json.

criterion.A: is_virtual AND non-void return AND a non-virtual method named without the leading underscore exists on the class or its ancestors (the engine consumes the result through that wrapper)
criterion.B: all other is_virtual entries (lifecycle/no-op or void side-effect hooks)
criterion.C: creation-info routed names not present in extension_api.json: _get, _get_property_list, _notification, _property_can_revert, _property_get_revert, _set, _to_string, _validate_property
